# A name-constrained private PKI. root_cert (self-signed, serial 1) permits DNS:corp.example and excludes DNS:test.corp.example.
# inter_cert (serial 2, pathlen 0) permits DNS:eng.corp.example; inter_open_cert (serial 3, pathlen 0) carries no nameConstraints.
# Leaves carry EKU serverAuth+clientAuth, SAN as named, and are signed by the issuer named in the first column:
#   in_scope_leaf_cert            inter       build.eng.corp.example   accepted
#   root_scope_leaf_cert          inter       app.corp.example         inside the root, outside inter: refused
#   out_of_scope_leaf_cert        inter       bank.example             refused by both
#   open_in_scope_leaf_cert       inter_open  app.corp.example         accepted
#   open_out_of_scope_leaf_cert   inter_open  bank.example             refused only by the root's permitted subtree
#   excluded_leaf_cert            inter_open  x.test.corp.example      refused by the root's excluded subtree
#   direct_in_scope_leaf_cert     root        app.corp.example         accepted
#   direct_out_of_scope_leaf_cert root        bank.example             refused
#   apple_in_scope_leaf_cert      root        mac.corp.example         accepted; valid 2020-01-01..2022-03-01 (790 days, inside Apple's 825-day leaf cap)
#   apple_out_of_scope_leaf_cert  root        bank.example             refused; same 790-day window
# Every other certificate is valid 2020-01-01..2099-12-31. All ecdsa-with-SHA256, P-256, keys not stored.
# Generated with OpenSSL 3.6.1 (C:\Strawberry\c\bin\openssl.exe; NB=20200101000000Z, NA=20991231000000Z, NA2=20220301000000Z; MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*'):
#   openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out X.key   (each certificate)
#   openssl req -new -x509 -key root.key -sha256 -subj "/CN=TlsLib NC Root" -set_serial 1 -not_before NB -not_after NA
#     -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" -addext "subjectKeyIdentifier=hash"
#     -addext "nameConstraints=critical,permitted;DNS:corp.example,excluded;DNS:test.corp.example" -out root.pem
#   openssl req -new -key X.key -subj "<subject>" -out X.csr
#   openssl x509 -req -in X.csr -CA <issuer>.pem -CAkey <issuer>.key -set_serial N -sha256 -not_before NB -not_after NA -extfile X.ext -out X.pem
#     inter.ext:      basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE,pathlen:0 / keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign / subjectKeyIdentifier=hash /
#                     authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid / nameConstraints=critical,permitted;DNS:eng.corp.example   (CN=TlsLib NC Intermediate, serial 2)
#     inter_open.ext: the same without nameConstraints   (CN=TlsLib NC Open Intermediate, serial 3)
#     leaf .ext:      basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth,clientAuth /
#                     subjectAltName=DNS:<san> / subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid   (CN=<san>, serials 4..13 in the order above)
#   openssl verify -CAfile root.pem -untrusted inter.pem -untrusted inter_open.pem X.pem:
#     in_scope, open_in_scope, direct_in_scope OK; root_scope, out_of_scope, open_out_of_scope, direct_out_of_scope fail with "permitted subtree violation";
#     excluded fails with "excluded subtree violation"; the apple pair is OK / permitted-subtree failure with -attime 1609459200
#   openssl x509 -in X.pem -outform DER | xxd -p   (each field)
root_
inter_
inter_open_
in_scope_leaf_
root_scope_leaf_
out_of_scope_leaf_
open_in_scope_leaf_
open_out_of_scope_leaf_
excluded_leaf_
direct_in_scope_leaf_
direct_out_of_scope_leaf_
apple_in_scope_leaf_
apple_out_of_scope_leaf_
